sloka: दर्शयेक्ष्वाकुशार्दूल वीर्यं गात्रेषु मे लघु।ततस्त्वां भक्षयिष्यामि दृष्टपौरुषविक्रमम् ।। ६.६७.१३९ ।।
transliteration: darśayekṣvākuśārdūla vīryaṁ gātreṣu me laghu।tatastvāṁ bhakṣayiṣyāmi dṛṣṭapauruṣavikramam ।। 6.67.139 ।।

translations.english: Mighty Rama, who is extremely difficult to win over, went with full conviction followed by Lakshmana and surrounded by vanara troops.
